answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in jetty, expire in vertex, and karst lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 137 aliases as a result needs 190 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 177 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
